policy: These are deterministic elapsed-time defaults for one already-established substantive procedure stage. The caller selects only a closed procedure kind against the fresh scene; the caller never supplies seconds. The causal scheduler remains the sole authority that actually advances world time and may interrupt the procedure at an earlier player-facing boundary.

brief_exchange.use: A short but substantive exchange, routine debrief question, or narrow administrative interaction whose content has already been staged.

substantive_conversation.use: A multi-person or consequential conversation with several meaningful exchanges but no longer formal agenda.

briefing.use: Mission, command, intelligence, or operational briefing for an already-established audience and subject.

team_checkin.use: A substantive player-led team check-in, after-action discussion, or leadership review.

training_review.use: An after-action/training review, instruction block, or focused correction session distinct from the training session itself.

medical_consultation.use: A non-emergency examination, consultation, or treatment-planning stage whose medical outcome is separately owned by medical mechanics.

negotiation_session.use: A substantive negotiation or institutional discussion stage before any separately persisted agreement or commitment.

examination_evaluation.use: A substantive practical examination/evaluation stage involving observation, execution, and review. The examination outcome remains owned by its domain reducer.

council_session.use: A formal council, command conference, political session, or comparable multi-party agenda block.

invariants: Procedure-time settlement never creates the procedure, outcome, agreement, medical result, examination score, training gain, or relationship consequence.
The current scene must allow time passage, must not be in active combat, and must not already require a protected player decision.
The supplied scene_id must exactly match the current authoritative scene so stale conversational context cannot consume time.
Soft player-facing events interrupt event-seeking settlement for presentation without being promoted into protected player choices.
A hard protected decision stops settlement immediately.
Internal scheduler boundaries may require bounded continuation toward the same authored procedure target.
